# runlab-client

> Python client and HTTP spec for the RunLab research API: pre-register an A-vs-B
> comparison, record each seed's metric, and get a verdict. The verdict comes from a paired
> test with a 95 % confidence interval, checked against the plan. It refuses a misleading
> comparison and says which wins a write-up may quote. The client uses only the standard
> library; you need a RunLab server URL and token (env RUNLAB_URL, RUNLAB_TOKEN).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): quickstart, the loop, verdict codes, studies, errors, client reference
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how a coding agent should run the loop and report the result
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](openapi.json): 10 operations under /api/v1, bearer-token auth

## Examples

- [quickstart.py](examples/quickstart.py): plan, 10 seeds per arm, compare
- [curl.sh](examples/curl.sh): the same loop with curl

## Optional

- [Client source](src/runlab_client/__init__.py): one file, about 220 lines
